DEF.actual: BASE CAI-JED +30 pages (page 1 hasMoreResults=true) but the next page failed on 2/2 attempts here (and 5 of 5 times in probes made before the run): HTTP 409; ErrorCode NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999; ErrorMessage "NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999"; Context [{"Name":"TimedOut","Value":"Request Timed Out or Canceled"}]; envelope PascalCase after 10386 ms / HTTP 409; ErrorCode NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999; ErrorMessage "NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999"; Context [{"Name":"TimedOut","Value":"Request Timed Out or Canceled"}]; envelope PascalCase after 10310 ms. The 409 is a supplier timeout (Context TimedOut) carried as an unclassified Z9999 error. The same endpoint pages correctly for JED-CAI +30 (page 2 in 2516 ms), so the failure depends on the route/date, not on the endpoint being down.
